The models and textures in this folder come from "Medieval Village MegaKit" (Standard version) by Quaternius.
https://quaternius.itch.io/medieval-village-megakit

The materials were rebuilt for this project by Tools/import_medieval_village.py; the M_HKVillage* parent
materials are part of this project, not of the kit.
